style.backgroundSystem: seamless violet-black studio cyclorama #120A28 with an optional blue-to-magenta wireframe sound-wave mesh (#2E6BFF to #D624A0) or a magenta-to-blue halftone dot field as the only graphic layer; one angular faceted violet backdrop panel for transition screens

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium dark-tech audio ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep violet-black backdrop #120A28, glossy plinth violet #4A1FA0, near-white headline text #F2F0FF, muted lilac body text #B9AFDD, and one accent magenta #D624A0; cool low-key tone; backgrounds are seamless violet-black studio cycloramas with at most one graphic layer, either a blue-to-magenta wireframe sound-wave mesh running from #2E6BFF to #D624A0 or a magenta-to-blue halftone dot field; recurring surface is a round violet display podium with a thin raised rim; lighting is a large soft front-left key with a crisp violet rim light, deep falloff at the frame edges, one controlled specular streak on gloss, and a soft contact shadow that grounds the product; modern geometric sans-serif only, oversized two-line headline balanced against the product mass, a thin three-tick rule in #FFFFFF, #E4002B and #FFD400 as the only decorative motif, thin-line monochrome icons and circular plus marks; stable product scale, stable podium height, straight lines and ellipses kept geometrically true; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no added bloom, no watermark, no QR code.
noDrift: no added lens flare or bloom effects
no watermark, store badge or QR code
style.presentationRules: product scale and podium height stay constant across screens; product mass always balanced against the text column; arched lines and ellipses rendered geometrically true, no perspective warp; identical angle and light on both panels of any comparison
style.surfaceSystem: round violet display podium / turntable plinth in #4A1FA0 with a thin raised rim, matte dark floor wrap; matte desk surface only on the lifestyle screen
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; oversized two-line left-or-right aligned headline in #F2F0FF, body labels in #B9AFDD, headline 28-44pt, subtitle 15-20pt, label 12-14pt, thin letter-spaced latin side caption used as a layout rule only
